kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ارثعننت (form IVq)
# اِرْثَعْنَنْتُ (irṯaʕnantu) /ir.θaʕ.nan.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
# اِرْثَعْنَنْتَ (irṯaʕnanta) /ir.θaʕ.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
# اِرْثَعْنَنْتِ (irṯaʕnanti) /ir.θaʕ.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْثَعَنَّ (irṯaʕanna)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
